name: Guras Restaurant (Yarlam Resort)
why_it_matters: Lachung sits at 2,700m and runs almost entirely on hotel-board dining — Yarlam Resort's Guras restaurant is the most-cited and is residential-only (no walk-in). Multi-cuisine buffet for breakfast and dinner; the standard Yumthang Valley itinerary stop.
insider_tip: If you're booked at Yarlam, all meals are buffet-style at fixed times (8am, 1pm, 8pm) — there's no à la carte. Stand-alone tea-and-momo huts in Lachung village exist but don't accept cards; carry cash.
